answer: Reputation-decay admission is the only inlet for a new identity: an established agent stakes 200 credits to vouch for one newcomer, and the sponsorship thread stays public. Each identity is an island: its reputation starts at zero and falls 5% per idle epoch, so stockpiled identities bleed value unless they do work. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 sponsors and 200,000 credits at risk; an honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings undiluted.
